purpose: Authoritative provenance contract for future material-data verification
preferred_source_order: manufacturer technical data with traceable revision
rules: Generic web pages are not sufficient provenance for design-critical values.
Alloy, temper and product-form context must be retained where relevant.
Ranges must not be silently converted into single allowables.
Secondary values remain screening-only unless independently verified.
Conflicting sources must be preserved and adjudicated rather than silently overwritten.
